teacherNote: Marked against: Formula for area of sector = (θ/360°) × πr² (1); Substitution of θ = 60° / r = 7 cm / and π = 22/7 into the area formula (1); Calculation and correct final answer with units (77/3 cm² or 25.67 cm²) (1). You used the formula for the length of an arc of a sector, (θ/360) × 2πr, instead of the formula for the area of a sector, (θ/360) × πr². Be careful to distinguish between linear measurements (arc length) and surface measurements (area).
